description: ZSetMerkle cross-language conformance vectors. F# is the reference oracle for this seed: each case builds a Z-set from entries, removes zero-net weights, sorts leaves by UTF-8 encoded key bytes, encodes each leaf as [uint32_le key_len][key_bytes][int64_le weight], hashes leaves and internal nodes with XxHash128 into MerkleHash(hi, lo), and renders roots as lowercase hi[16] + lo[16] hex.
hash: XxHash128 via System.IO.Hashing.XxHash128; MerkleHash reads digest bytes as lo=uint64_le(bytes[0..7]), hi=uint64_le(bytes[8..15]) and renders hi then lo.
leafEncoding: uint32_le key byte length, raw UTF-8 key bytes, int64_le signed weight
ordering: ascending lexicographic order over raw encoded key bytes, not culture-sensitive string comparison

laws.determinism: same net Z-set and same key encoder produce the same root
laws.retraction: entries whose signed weights sum to zero are absent from the support and do not affect the root
laws.orderIndependence: input order does not affect the root; canonical leaf order is by encoded key bytes
laws.nonAsciiOrdering: non-ASCII keys are ordered by UTF-8 bytes for the Merkle leaf order
